## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`
- [ ] Evidence gates clean: `python scripts/validate_evidence.py`
- [ ] For new/changed data: source-backed values cite a source; estimates and bridges are labeled honestly
- [ ] Diff is scoped and coherent; no unrelated changes
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the DCO — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
